title: Residency, read: leave_countdown on arriving wild units, its initial value, its slope, and the tick they leave
fork: measures L4 (how long a group stays); precondition for E9b, E9c, E10

predictions.model: countdown is a per-unit tick timer set at spawn
predictions.expects: every member of a wave carries the same initial value at first sighting (to within one sample of 200 ticks); it falls by ~1 per tick; the unit is gone within a few thousand ticks of reaching 0

predictions.model: countdown is per group or set lazily
predictions.expects: members differ at first sighting, or the value does not fall linearly, or units leave while it is still far above 0
different species arriving in the same replicate carry different initial values

kill_criterion: This arm is a measurement, not a kill. It fails as an instrument if the positive control fails: releasing the hold on the group present at load must bring a new wave within 4000 ticks (L1 says ~1500).
culling: drop a replicate on any liveness breach (tick stalled, popup queue non-empty after a step, tool state changed, unit count insane)
drop a replicate whose save folder differs from the backup at the end
drop the arm if the positive control fails in two of three replicates
report initial countdowns only for units first seen within one sample of their arrival tick (all arrivals are, by construction)
